note: Synthetic Impressum pages for session A4. Every company, person, street, town, postcode, phone, register and VAT number is invented; every domain ends in .example (RFC 2606). Fields come only from the Impressum page itself. address: postal address of the operator (street with house number exactly as written, five-digit postcode without a "D-" prefix, town as written without country and trailing punctuation); a Postfach is not an address; addresses of agencies, photographers, hosting providers, arbitration boards, chambers, authorities, insurers and external data protection officers are not the operator's; with several operator addresses the first in reading order. email: the operator's first e-mail in reading order, lower case; form is plain (visible text, also when written by a script), mailto (only in a mailto: link), obfuscated ([at], (at), {at}, [ät], " at " with an E-Mail or Mail label on the same line, [dot], (dot), " dot ", [punkt]) or cloudflare (/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#hex, first byte is the XOR key); an address only in an image or reversed in the DOM is null. handelsregister: HRA or HRB, number as digits only, court = town of the register court or null; PR, VR and GnR do not count; a Gerichtsstand is not a register court. ustId: DE plus 9 digits without spaces; a Steuernummer or an IBAN is not a VAT ID. accessibilityStatement: href exactly as written of a link to an accessibility statement, not of a toolbar link (href "#" or javascript:). null always means "nicht gefunden, bitte manuell prüfen". Page 08 embeds the address as a base64 SVG image (the SVG contains only its namespace URI); page 09 has no Cloudflare decode script.

01-gmbh-klassisch.description:
GmbH, classic layout: "Angaben gemäß § 5 DDG", multi-line address with
and a house number with a separate letter, plain e-mail, HRB and "Amtsgericht X" on one line, USt-IdNr after the § 27 a UStG label.

02-einzelunternehmen-at-eckig.description: Sole trader (Inhaberin), e-mail hidden with "[at]", USt-IdNr, no commercial register, chamber named without an address.

03-gbr-at-dot-rund.description: GbR with two partners, e-mail hidden with "(at)" and "(dot)", Kleinunternehmer note that names the USt-IdNr label but gives no number, no register.

04-ek-registergericht-getrennt.description: e.K. (eingetragener Kaufmann): "Registergericht: Amtsgericht X" and "Registernummer: HRA ..." in two separate paragraphs, town with a hyphenated district.

05-eine-zeile-kommas.description: Everything in one paragraph separated by commas: company, street with an attached letter, postcode and town, phone, e-mail, managing director, register court and HRB, USt-IdNr.

06-tabelle.description:
Table layout with label cells "Firma", "Anschrift", "E-Mail", "Registergericht", "Registernummer", "USt-ID"; the address cell has a
.

07-mailto-linktext.description: The e-mail exists only as a mailto: link (with a ?subject= query) whose text is "E-Mail schreiben"; the address is not in the visible text. UG (haftungsbeschränkt).

08-email-als-bild.description: The e-mail is shown only as an image (base64 data: SVG) whose alt text does not contain the address, so it is not readable as text: email null (manual check).

09-cloudflare-email.description: Cloudflare email protection markup (link to /cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#hex and a span with data-cfemail) without the decode script, so the visible text is "[email protected]"; the address is the XOR-decoded hex (key 0x4a).

10-email-umgedreht.description: The only e-mail is written reversed in the DOM and flipped back for the eye by CSS (unicode-bidi: bidi-override; direction: rtl); the text a scanner reads is reversed: email null (manual check).

11-nur-postfach.description: Only a Postfach with postcode and town, no street address: address null (manual check). Register and VAT ID are present.

12-dorf-ortsteil.description: Village-style street without a suffix such as -straße or -weg, and a town with a hyphenated district.

13-plz-mit-d-praefix.description: Postcode written with a "D-" prefix and the country "Deutschland" on the next line; the town is given without the country.

14-telefon-fax-fuenfstellig.description: Phone and fax numbers with five-digit groups stand right before the street address (each on its own line); they must not be taken for postcodes.

15-agentur-vor-betreiber.description: A web-agency credit and a photo credit, each with its own street address and e-mail, come before the operator block in reading order; the operator block is expected. The register court is a town name with spaces.

16-schlichtungsstelle-danach.description: Operator block first, then a consumer arbitration board (Verbraucherschlichtungsstelle) with its own address, website and e-mail; only the operator data are expected.

17-hrb-mit-b-suffix.description: Berlin-style register number with a trailing " B" ("HRB ... B") after "Amtsgericht X"; the number is expected without the suffix.

18-ustid-mit-leerzeichen.description: OHG with HRA; the USt-IdNr is written with spaces in groups of three ("DE ... ... ..."); the value is expected without spaces.

19-iban-und-steuernummer.description: A German IBAN (DE plus 20 digits in groups of four, invalid check digits 00) and a Steuernummer, but no VAT ID: ustId null. No register.

20-englisch-legal-notice.description: English page: "Legal notice", address followed by "Germany", "Email: info (at) ...", "Commercial register: Local court X, HRB ...", "VAT ID: DE...", and an "Accessibility statement" link in the footer.

21-impressum-und-datenschutz.description: Combined page "Impressum und Datenschutz": the Impressum comes first, then a long privacy text that names a hosting provider, an external data protection officer and a supervisory authority with their own addresses and e-mails. No register.

22-hr-b-mit-leerzeichen-ag.description: Register written "HR B ..." with a space and "AG X" (Amtsgericht) right after the number; a Steuernummer is present too, besides the USt-IdNr.

23-at-dot-woerter-partg.description: E-mail written with the words " at " and " dot " after the label "E-Mail:" on the same line. A Partnerschaftsgesellschaft with a PR number (not HRA/HRB): handelsregister null. Chamber and professional liability insurer with their own addresses come after the operator.

24-zwei-betreiber-emails.description: Two operator e-mails: a general info address first, a data protection address later in the page; the first is expected.

25-hausnummernbereich-abkuerzung.description: Abbreviated street with a house number range ("...str. 12-14", hyphen) and a town with an abbreviation that belongs to the name ("... a. Inn"). GmbH & Co. KG with HRA.

26-mittelpunkte-und-pipes.description: Address on one line separated by middle dots ("Name · Street · Postcode Town"), contact line separated by pipes; the header shows the company name and a phone number with five-digit groups before the Impressum.

27-erklaerung-barrierefreiheit.description: Online shop with a link "Erklärung zur Barrierefreiheit" in the footer, next to AGB and Widerrufsbelehrung.

28-barrierefreiheit-toolbar.description: A link "Barrierefreiheit anpassen" with href "#" opens an accessibility toolbar; there is no accessibility statement: accessibilityStatement null.

29-email-per-skript.description: The e-mail is assembled by an inline script at page load and written as text into an empty span; the HTML source never contains the address in one piece, the rendered page shows it as plain text.

30-fast-leer.description: Nearly empty Impressum: only a company name and "Kontakt über unser Formular" with a link to the contact page; every field null (manual check).

32-email-ae-dot-eckig.description: E-mail hidden with "[ät]" and "[dot]" after the label "Mail:"; house number with an attached letter.

33-verein-vereinsregister.description: Registered association (e.V.) with a Vereinsregister number (VR) at an Amtsgericht and a Steuernummer: neither is HRA/HRB nor a VAT ID, so handelsregister and ustId are null.

34-hrb-ohne-gericht-gerichtsstand.description: HRB number without a register court; a "Gerichtsstand" (place of jurisdiction) follows, which is not a register court: court null.

35-bereich-gedankenstrich-opf.description: House number range with an en dash ("12–14") and a town whose name ends with an abbreviation and a period ("i.d.OPf."); the e-mail has capital letters and is expected in lower case.

36-hauptsitz-und-filiale.description: Two operator addresses (Hauptsitz first, Filiale second): the first is expected. A link "Barrierefreiheitserklärung" with an absolute URL inside the main text.

37-genossenschaft-gnr.description: Cooperative (eG) with a Genossenschaftsregister number (GnR) at an Amtsgericht: not HRA/HRB, so handelsregister null; the VAT ID is present.
